storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/swpcxray/ (gz after 2 days)
source: NOAA SWPC GOES primary X-ray flux (services.swpc.noaa.gov/json/goes/primary/xrays-1-day.json)

field_map.energy: energy band: 0.05-0.4nm (short) or 0.1-0.8nm (long, used for GOES flare classification)
field_map.electron_contamination: NOAA's own contamination flag for this reading, or null (upstream field is spelled 'electron_contaminaton' — normalized here)

confidence_model: RAW official readings, both energy bands archived. NOAA's own published flux -> GOES flare-class formula (A/B/C/M/X) is applied for display (classifyFlare), not a derived/fitted signal.
cadence: 5-min poll of a ~1-minute-resolution, 1-day rolling upstream window
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Paired stream: swpckindex.json (planetary K-index, same PR). Cache/display history caps to the long band's most recent 180 points (~3h) — the archive keeps everything, only the client payload is capped.
